full_inspection: All four complete native images of copy1site048 and copy2site124 were inspected. Every body line, paragraph, punctuation mark, numeral, underline, correction and margin was compared; audit_124_details.jpg records the inserted word, placement stroke, overstrike and unequal point after avec. Apart from the four recorded loci, the body readings agree.
original_transcription_comparison: Both original transcriptions were compared in full. Their body differences are the algébrique insertion and r/t overwrite; the copy1 checked point after avec was independently compared and is absent from copy2. The archive numbers and scan metadata are copy-specific. Uncertainty was added to the covered lower r after direct inspection.

entries.decision: retain the inserted word and its observed placement as a copy2 addition
entries.reason: The handwritten algébrique stands above the line; a curved descending placement stroke enters the gap between géométrie and dans. Both components were inspected together as the insertion locus.

entries.decision: retain the clear replacement and the doubtful lower layer
entries.reason: The copy2 handwritten t replaces the r position; its thick stem masks much of the lower letter. Copy1 clearly reads répéré. The copy2 reading is preserved with uncertainty on the covered r only.
The tiny baseline point after avec is visible in copy1 and absent in copy2. The category records the body-reading difference without assigning an origin to the point.
The lower-left inscriptions read48 and124; no authorship attribution is made.
